01 / MEET THE FOUNDER

A multidisciplinary perspective.
Design roots. Business thinking. Founder leadership.

Anas is the founder of Dechub. His background brings together design, brand execution, marketing, and business strategy.

With over a decade of experience at Titan Company Limited, where he held senior and lead design roles, he brings a practical understanding of how brands communicate and connect with customers.

Today, he leads Dechub with a belief that strategy, design, technology, and execution work best together. His perspective considers how an experience looks, functions, and evolves with the business.

03 / BUILDING DECHUB

One connected experience.

Bringing brand, design, technology, and execution together around the needs of a business.

The belief behind Dechub

Anas founded Dechub around a clear idea: businesses benefit when their brand, digital experiences, and operational systems work together.

That belief shapes the company’s work across identity, digital products, content, campaigns, and automation, with a focus on consistency, practicality, and sustainable growth.

07 / FOUNDER PHILOSOPHY

Discipline. Clarity. Continuous improvement.

Anas’s outlook is shaped by persistence, strategic thinking, and a commitment to improving over time. His black belt in Karate reflects the discipline he values beyond business and brings into his professional life.

A practical mindset

Understand the challenge, think deliberately, and keep refining the work. These values connect his personal journey with his approach to leading Dechub.
